title: Fixed Perforated Cup and Raised Handle Garlic Press
description: One newly authored complete static hand garlic-press appearance in a fixed open pose. One continuous metal lower body forms a deep rectangular open cup with sixteen genuine complete finite bottom openings and a full long lower handle. Two integral ears hold a transverse axis; a separate whole upper metal handle and finite recessed press block rotate together into one fixed raised display pose. Two complete dark grip coverings and two full axle retainers complete the entire tool. This is not the old high-column citrus press scaled down, nor the crossed serrated pliers with a replacement jaw; no old geometry payload is reused. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Empty static display only, no food, squeezing or cutting performance, pressure, moving articulation, ergonomic fit, food-contact suitability, manufacture or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
